points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 维利·勃兰特1913年12月18日出生于德国吕贝克，原名赫伯特·恩斯特·卡尔·弗拉姆。他的母亲是一位单身母亲，在百货公司工作。勃兰特的早年生活相对贫困，但他通过勤奋学习获得了良好的教育。1929年，他加入德国社会民主党(SPD)，开始参与政治活动。1930年，他成为社会主义工人青年团(SAJ)的成员，并开始使用笔名'维利·勃兰特'。这段时期塑造了他对社会正义和平等的坚定信念，也为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Willy Brandt was born as Herbert Ernst Karl Frahm on December 18, 1913, in Lübeck, Germany. His mother was a single working woman in a department store. Brandt's early life was relatively modest, but he received a good education through hard work. In 1929, he joined the Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD), beginning his political involvement. In 1930, he became a member of the Socialist Workers Youth (SAJ) and adopted the pseudonym 'Willy Brandt.' This period shaped his firm beliefs in social justice and equality, laying the foundation for his later political career.

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 1933年纳粹上台后，勃兰特因政治活动被迫流亡。他首先前往丹麦，后于1934年移居挪威，在那里担任记者并继续政治活动。1937年，他成为挪威公民。二战期间，勃兰特在挪威抵抗运动中发挥重要作用，同时密切关注德国国内情况。1940年德国占领挪威后，他逃往瑞典，在那里继续反法西斯活动。这段流亡经历使勃兰特对民主制度和人权有了更深刻的理解，也培养了他对极权主义的坚定抵抗立场，这些价值观后来成为他政治理念的核心。
points.descriptionEn: After the Nazi rise to power in 1933, Brandt was forced into exile due to his political activities. He first went to Denmark, then moved to Norway in 1934, where he worked as a journalist and continued his political work. In 1937, he became a Norwegian citizen. During World War II, Brandt played an important role in the Norwegian resistance movement while closely following developments in Germany. When Germany occupied Norway in 1940, he fled to Sweden, where he continued his anti-fascist activities. This exile experience gave Brandt a deeper understanding of democratic systems and human rights, and cultivated his firm stance against totalitarianism, which became central to his political philosophy.

points.title: 重返德国
points.description: 1945年二战结束后，勃兰特返回德国，最初在美军占领区工作。1946年，他重新加入德国社会民主党，并迅速在党内崭露头角。1949年，他当选为西柏林市议会主席，并在这一职位上工作了7年。在柏林期间，勃兰特致力于重建城市，同时坚定地站在对抗共产主义的前线。他成为西柏林的象征，代表西方盟国在冷战前沿的存在。1957年，他当选为西柏林市长，这一职位使他成为国际知名的政治人物，也为他后来担任联邦德国总理奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the end of World War II in 1945, Brandt returned to Germany, initially working in the American occupation zone. In 1946, he rejoined the Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD) and quickly rose to prominence within the party. In 1949, he was elected Chairman of the Berlin City Council, a position he held for seven years. During his time in Berlin, Brandt focused on rebuilding the city while firmly standing on the front lines against communism. He became a symbol of West Berlin, representing the presence of Western allies in the Cold War's frontline. In 1957, he was elected Mayor of West Berlin, making him an internationally known political figure and laying the groundwork for his later service as Chancellor of West Germany.

points.title: 柏林市长
points.description: 作为西柏林市长，勃兰特面临巨大挑战，包括柏林墙的修建(1961年)和冷战紧张局势的加剧。他成功地将西柏林建设成为'自由的前哨'，改善了市民生活条件，推动了城市现代化。勃兰特在国际舞台上积极发声，为西柏林争取国际支持。1961年柏林墙建成后，他冷静应对危机，避免了与东德的直接冲突。这一时期，勃兰特的领导风格和外交才能得到充分展现，使他成为德国政坛的重要人物。1964年，他当选为德国社会民主党主席，进一步巩固了在党内的领导地位。
points.descriptionEn: As Mayor of West Berlin, Brandt faced enormous challenges, including the construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961 and escalating Cold War tensions. He successfully transformed West Berlin into a 'frontier of freedom,' improving living conditions for citizens and promoting urban modernization. Brandt actively voiced West Berlin's interests on the international stage, securing international support for the city. After the Berlin Wall was built in 1961, he calmly managed the crisis, avoiding direct conflict with East Germany. During this period, Brandt's leadership style and diplomatic skills were fully demonstrated, establishing him as a major figure in German politics. In 1964, he was elected Chairman of the SPD, further consolidating his leadership position within the party.

points.title: 联邦总理
points.description: 1966年，勃兰特出任联邦德国副总理兼外交部长，开始参与国家层面的决策。1969年，他当选为联邦德国总理，开始推行著名的'东方政策'(Ostpolitik)。这一政策旨在改善与东欧国家的关系，承认战后欧洲的现实，同时坚持德国的统一目标。1970年，他分别与苏联和波兰签署《莫斯科条约》和《华沙条约》，正式承认战后边界。1971年，他因推动东方政策获得诺贝尔和平奖。1972年，他成功签署《基础条约》，实现东西德关系正常化。然而，1974年，他的总理任期因盖世太保间谍丑闻(Guillaume Affair)而提前结束，这一事件成为他政治生涯的重大挫折。
points.descriptionEn: In 1966, Brandt became Vice Chancellor and Foreign Minister of West Germany, beginning to participate in national-level decision-making. In 1969, he was elected Federal Chancellor of West Germany and began implementing his famous 'Ostpolitik' (Eastern Policy). This policy aimed to improve relations with Eastern European countries, recognize the realities of post-war Europe, while maintaining the goal of German reunification. In 1970, he signed the Moscow Treaty with the Soviet Union and the Warsaw Treaty with Poland, formally recognizing post-war borders. In 1971, he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts to promote Eastern Policy. In 1972, he successfully signed the Basic Treaty, normalizing relations between East and West Germany. However, his chancellorship ended prematurely in 1974 due to the Guillaume Affair, a major setback in his political career.

points.title: 晚年政治
points.description: 辞去总理职务后，勃兰特继续担任德国社会民主党主席至1987年。他积极参与国际事务，担任社会党国际主席(1976-1992)，推动全球南北对话。勃兰特还主持了著名的'勃兰特委员会'，关注发展中国家的发展问题。1983年，他公开反对美国在德国部署中程核导弹，表现出独立的政治立场。尽管健康状况恶化，勃兰特仍继续参与公共事务，直到1990年德国统一后，他发表了对德国未来的思考。1992年10月8日，勃兰特在波恩去世，享年78岁。他的葬礼吸引了来自世界各地的政治领袖，彰显了他在国际舞台上的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: After resigning as Chancellor, Brandt continued as Chairman of the SPD until 1987. He remained active in international affairs, serving as President of the Socialist International (1976-1992) and promoting North-South dialogue globally. Brandt also chaired the famous 'Brandt Commission,' focusing on development issues in developing countries. In 1983, he publicly opposed the deployment of intermediate-range nuclear missiles by the United States in Germany, demonstrating his independent political stance. Despite deteriorating health, Brandt continued to engage in public affairs until after German reunification in 1990, when he published his thoughts on Germany's future. Brandt died in Bonn on October 8, 1992, at the age of 78. His funeral attracted political leaders from around the world, highlighting his significant international standing.

supporter.zh: 勃兰特被支持者视为德国战后最重要的政治家之一，他的东方政策彻底改变了德国在欧洲的地位，使德国从冷战前线转变为东西方之间的桥梁。他勇于面对历史，1970年在华沙犹太人纪念碑前下跪的'勃兰特之跪'成为德国反思历史的象征。勃兰特推动了德国与邻国的和解，为欧洲一体化奠定了基础。他的政治生涯体现了勇气、远见和道德勇气，为现代德国的政治文化树立了标杆。
supporter.en: Supporters view Brandt as one of the most important post-war German politicians, whose Ostpolitik fundamentally changed Germany's position in Europe, transforming it from the Cold War frontline into a bridge between East and West. His courage in facing history, exemplified by the 'Kniefall von Warschau' (Warsaw genuflection) at the Jewish Monument in 1970, became a symbol of Germany's historical reflection. Brandt promoted reconciliation with Germany's neighbors, laying the foundation for European integration. His political career exemplifies courage, vision, and moral courage, setting a benchmark for modern German political culture.

critic.zh: 批评者认为勃兰特的东方政策过于妥协，牺牲了德国的国家利益和道义立场。他们指责他对东德的让步实际上加强了共产主义政权的合法性，忽视了东德人民的苦难。此外，勃兰特被批评在处理国内经济问题上不够果断，未能有效解决通货膨胀和失业问题。盖世太保间谍丑闻也暴露了他在安全审查方面的疏忽。批评者认为，尽管勃兰特在国际舞台上获得赞誉，但他在国内政策上的成就有限，未能实现其承诺的社会改革。
critic.en: Critics argue that Brandt's Ostpolitik was too compromising, sacrificing German national interests and moral principles. They accuse his concessions to East Germany of actually strengthening the legitimacy of the communist regime while ignoring the suffering of the East German people. Additionally, Brandt is criticized for being indecisive in addressing domestic economic issues, failing to effectively tackle inflation and unemployment. The Guillaume Affair also revealed his negligence in security matters. Critics contend that despite his international acclaim, Brandt achieved limited success in domestic policy, failing to deliver on his promised social reforms.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为勃兰特是德国战后政治转型的关键人物，他的政策使德国摆脱了战后的孤立状态，重新融入国际社会。在流行文化中，勃兰特常被塑造为勇于认错的道德楷模，尤其是'勃兰特之跪'已成为国际关系史上的标志性时刻。然而，学者们也指出，勃兰特的成就离不开当时的国际环境和前任政府的铺垫。他的政治遗产复杂而深远，既包括成功的对外政策，也包括国内政策的局限性。勃兰特代表了德国从战后分裂到重新统一的过渡时期，他的政治生涯反映了20世纪后半叶欧洲地缘政治的变迁。
objective.en: Historians generally regard Brandt as a key figure in Germany's post-war political transformation, whose policies helped Germany overcome post-war isolation and reintegrate into the international community. In popular culture, Brandt is often portrayed as a moral exemplar willing to acknowledge mistakes, with the 'Warsaw genuflection' becoming an iconic moment in international relations history. However, scholars also note that Brandt's achievements were made possible by the international context and groundwork laid by previous governments. His political legacy is complex and profound, encompassing both successful foreign policies and limitations in domestic policy. Brandt represents the transitional period from Germany's post-war division to reunification, and his political career reflects the geopolitical changes in Europe during the latter half of the 20th century.

self.zh: 和平不是靠祈祷得来的，而是靠勇气和决心争取的。
self.en: Peace is not something that can be prayed for. It must be fought for and won.

others.zh: 维利·勃兰特的东方政策是德国战后历史上最伟大的外交成就之一，它不仅改变了德国在欧洲的地位，也为整个欧洲的和平与和解铺平了道路。
others.en: Willy Brandt's Ostpolitik was one of the greatest diplomatic achievements in German post-war history; it not only changed Germany's position in Europe but also paved the way for peace and reconciliation throughout the continent.
